truth_posts.original: I’m watching Right Side Broadcasting Network (RSBN) from Air Force One. They do a magnificent job of covering the Rallies, including the Interviews of people in lines that stretch for miles. So fascinating to see — So exciting! I love the Interviews they do of the people that are in line. Great Americans — They built this Country! There is Great Love and Respect in the air. Landing in Arizona now, then Montana. See you soon! President DONALD J. TRUMP
truth_posts.translated: 我正在观看空军一号的右侧广播网（ RSBN ）。他们在报道拉力赛方面做得非常出色，包括对长达数英里的队伍进行采访。看到它真是太迷人了—太令人兴奋了！我喜欢他们对排队人员进行的面试。伟大的美国人--他们建造了这个国家！空气中充满了巨大的爱和尊重。现在降落在亚利桑那州，然后是蒙大拿州。再见！唐纳德· J · T总统

We are the first Administration ever to turn Grants into money for America. Your great Businessman President running the Greatest Economy in the World — AN ALL-AROUND HUGE WIN FOR AMERICA! President DONALD J. TRUMP

truth_posts.original: I was just in Alaska launching the largest Energy Infrastructure Project in Alaska History— The Alaska LNG Project. I am also announcing today that my Commerce Secretary, Howard Lutnick, has secured an Offtake Commitment from Taiwan of between 70 to 80 Billion Dollars for Alaska LNG — That is 30% of the Pipeline for the next 20 years. This is the largest Offtake Agreement in History. On top of that, Taiwan has also agreed to Invest 4.4 Billion Dollars in Equity into the Project, because this is now a U.S. Federal Government Project, with all necessary permits secured, and all necessary authorizations delivered, and ready to go. This is the GREATEST Project in Alaska History, and this only happens with me in the White House. Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP
